## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy recognizable by his prominent goggle eyes, which appear noticeably worse in the moonlight than in the daylight. Additionally, his hands are known to be cold and fishy-feeling to the touch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Farewell P23](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane is an ambitious individual who aspires to pursue a career in politics and ultimately become a member of Parliament. As a Sophomore, he carries himself with an increasingly important demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)_

## History

Charlie Sloane had previously engaged in literary pursuits alongside his peers before preparing for higher education. Ahead of leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), he walked [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) home from an A. V. I. S. farewell party to spite [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and he subsequently traveled to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). While attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Charlie joined social outings with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), including an afternoon walk along the harbor shore.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends who move in the same social circle and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) together. Despite their bond, Charlie acts as a rival for the affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), even accompanying her home from a farewell party specifically because [Anne](../character/anne.md) wants to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). They continue to spend time together socially in small groups alongside their fellow students.

- Rival of — rivals in the good graces of a certain damsel (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- Friend of — longtime friends (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--charlie-sloane.md)

Charlie harbors strong romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne.md), eventually proposing marriage to her, though she rejects his proposal. He seizes opportunities to spend time with her, such as walking her home from a party or joining her on recreational walks alongside their college peers. Despite his romantic pursuits, [Anne](../character/anne.md) does not return his affections, causing their dynamic to remain unrequited on his end.

- Romantically involved with — proposed marriage to her and was rejected (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002)</sub>
